what: The golden numbers a clean install must reproduce (eir:bootstrap --fresh --with-client-inputs --build --run-engines --verify). Each value was recomputed from the database by App\Services\Eir\BaselineService::goldenActuals(); --verify recomputes it and compares, to the cent for amounts and exactly for counts.
note: Set from the second fresh bootstrap of the readiness branch (maiic_ifrs9_rc2, 15 October 2026), approved by Edward after the impact report v2. The 29 values that moved all trace to Eye Care Centre (104460000105) and Mudi SACCO (106050000012): their EIRs are no longer locked in a fresh build while held GL fee postings name them (FEE_HELD_FOR_LOAN), so their ECL is not discounted and their revenue rows drop out.
